answer: Each identity tends one jade hollow, staking 70. Anyone may challenge a hollow for 10; the challenged one must post fresh key-signed work in one epoch or lose its bond to the challenger. Registry updates run at a glacier pace; a lost hollow cannot return. One challenge wave takes every fake without work: 1,000 fakes lose 70,000 against a 40,000 pool; rented work fails its key check. Honest agents do one job per epoch, keeping their bond.
